brief.goal: Keep the private-LAN workbench owner-isolated and connect explicit create failures to a bounded Case-level fresh-Job reprepare flow without automatic platform retry.
database_write_scope: Task, Manifest, project state, docs, migration 073, Case-level attempt projection, corrective fresh-Job orchestration, LaunchAgent deployment and focused tests

allowed_writes: explicit private-LAN HTTP bind/origin configuration, LaunchAgent deployment, focused tests and mechanism documentation
one OceanEngine OAuth refresh under the existing credential_refresh_scope and exact confirmation variable
a local-only hidden-input Qiankun credential setup command; credentials may be written only to the gitignored mode-600 credential store and must never appear in argv, logs or tracked files
propagate the authenticated user's exact Qiankun owner key through existing readonly/monitor paths and reconnect monitor_plan_required to the existing bounded readonly monitor bridge
present a consumed explicit create failure as a bounded corrective Gate and allow the authenticated owner to create one idempotent fresh Job at a time for the next Case-level attempt
reuse original business parameters while regenerating system-derived name/time fields, Draft, payload hash, Plan/hash and confirmation; maximum three create actions per Case
forbidden_actions: all real monitor/resource/project writes, confirmations, creates, retries, budget or bid changes
new workflow node, business Gate, Plan/action type or confirmation phrase
automatic advertiser ownership transfer or rewriting historical runtime facts
raw credential, transcript, request, response, payload or sensitive URL persistence outside the approved gitignored mode-600 local credential stores
validation_plan: private-LAN bind/origin fail-closed policy and live Host/Origin/unauthenticated HTTP responses
local Qiankun credential create/replace, mode-600 storage and redacted output
authentication, forced password change, session revocation and admin read-only behavior
Intake owner match/mismatch, existing-account isolation and URL/API tampering
user detail/admin summary report cardinality and verified-only success semantics
schema, API, workflow, Case, runtime policy, conversation and diff checks
corrective Gate continue creates one idempotent fresh Job, remains platform-readonly, prepares the exact next Case attempt and cannot reuse the consumed Plan
Case attempts aggregate across Jobs; Attempt 3 failure reaches manual review; owner isolation and single confirmation remain enforced
stop_conditions: any real platform write other than the separately authorized single OAuth refresh would be required
the change would weaken exact Plan confirmation, single-attempt execution or authoritative readback
account ownership cannot be established by an exact active user owner key
a fourth Case-level std_project_create action or any automatic confirmation/create would be required
